name: Hayase Youko
source:
Hometown: Chiba Prefecture
Likes: Listening
Dislikes: Dogs
Favorite things: Cats, variety

[url=https://vndb.org/c30792]Hiroki's[/url] classmate who loves to gossip around and is always smiling. She is a member of the newspaper club and is often researching things that she finds interesting. Hates being called a journalist wannabe. Youko has recently found the Koizumi Dormitory to be very interesting and she wants to do an article about it. Loves cats and has three of them at her home.
